props.text: Commercial truck & trailer service in Texas and Oklahoma
Truck repair, trailer service and fleet maintenance at Summit Ridge Truck Center. Let’s get you rolling again.

When a truck or trailer is down, every hour costs you. Whether you run a regional fleet or a single tractor, you need a shop that understands your schedule and works to get you back on the road.

Our four shops service every major make and model with factory-trained technicians, current diagnostic software and a commitment to cutting downtime. From routine PMs and trailer repair to engine diagnostics and warranty work, the team at Summit Ridge delivers the dependable service your operation runs on.

stats.label: Full-service shops in Texas and Oklahoma

values.heading: Service that keeps your business moving
values.intro: As an authorized warranty and repair facility for the major engine and drivetrain makers, we handle warranty repairs and expert service on a wide range of commercial vehicles. Whether you run a Class 8 tractor, a medium-duty box truck, a refrigerated trailer or a vocational unit, you can count on our team for dependable repairs and honest recommendations.

cards.title: Digital repair estimating
cards.text: Our shop software builds detailed, itemized estimates from the diagnostic data, so you know the full scope and cost of a repair before any work starts.

cards.title: Computerized truck & trailer alignment
cards.text: Laser alignment finds problems early. Performed by trained technicians, it cuts uneven tire wear, sharpens steering and extends the life of suspension parts.

cards.title: Fabrication & welding shop
cards.text: Frame alterations, wheelbase changes, body mounts and liftgate repairs. Whether you are repairing damage or modifying a unit to suit the job, our welders build it to last.

cards.title: Repair and replace
cards.text: From aluminum and fiberglass panel repair to kingpins, landing gear, floors and lights, our trailer team brings your trailer back to road-ready condition.

cards.title: DOT safety inspections
cards.text: Annual and periodic inspections to federal and state standards, so you catch safety issues and fix them before they turn into violations or breakdowns.

cards.title: Liftgates
cards.text: Complete liftgate care: new installs, remounts, warranty repairs, hydraulic service and replacement parts for the major brands.

cards.title: Fleet PM programs
cards.text: Scheduled preventive maintenance planned around your routes, with reminders when units are due and a full service history for every truck.

cards.title: Express diagnostics
cards.text: A complete vehicle evaluation, repair assessment and written estimate within three hours of arrival, so you can make the call and get moving.

cards.title: Fleet service accounts
cards.text: One account for every unit and every location, with consolidated invoicing, approved spending limits and priority bay scheduling.

cards.title: Remote diagnostics
cards.text: Telematics-backed monitoring flags fault codes as they happen, so we can have parts and a bay ready before the truck pulls in.

cards.title: Fleet health reporting
cards.text: Monthly reports on repair history, cost per mile and upcoming maintenance across your fleet, so managers can plan instead of react.

cards.title: Mobile service
cards.text: Repairs, diagnostics and preventive maintenance at your yard or roadside, for when the truck can’t make it to the shop.

props.text: When the truck can’t come to us

Our mobile service team is equipped to handle many repairs and maintenance jobs at your location, helping you cut downtime and keep your operation moving without the hassle of hauling the vehicle in.

We can help with repairs, diagnostics and preventive maintenance when and where you need it.

image.alt: A Summit Ridge mobile service technician at work on a truck

values.heading: Plans that keep repair costs predictable

cards.title: Extended service contracts
cards.text: An unexpected repair can wreck an operating budget. An extended service contract protects your trucks from many unplanned repair costs and keeps spending predictable. We offer plans for owner-operators, fleets, municipalities and businesses that keep vehicles covered long after the factory warranty ends.

cards.title: Apply for credit with Summit Ridge
cards.text: With approved credit and a modest down payment, we offer an in-house line of credit for all your parts and service needs. Apply today and take advantage of flexible terms built to keep your business running smoothly.

image.alt: Genuine parts on the shelves at Summit Ridge

props.text: Quality repairs begin with quality parts

Our service department works hand in hand with the Summit Ridge parts department to make sure your truck or trailer gets the components it needs without delay. We stock a large inventory of genuine OEM and quality aftermarket parts, and if a part isn’t on the shelf our specialists source it through our supplier network to keep downtime to a minimum.

items.q: What types of vehicles does Summit Ridge service?
items.a: Our technicians service heavy- and medium-duty commercial trucks, trailers, buses and vocational vehicles. We work on all major makes and models.

items.q: Do you offer preventive fleet maintenance?
items.a: Yes. We set up PM programs around your routes and mileage, remind you when each unit is due and keep a full service record for every vehicle.
Yes. We are an authorized warranty facility for the major engine and drivetrain makers, and our team handles the claim paperwork for you.
Yes. Every location has dedicated trailer bays for structural repair, floors, doors, lights, brakes, kingpins, landing gear and liftgates.

items.q: How quickly can you diagnose my truck?
items.a: Our express diagnostics program delivers a complete evaluation and written estimate within three hours of arrival at participating shops.
Appointments get you the fastest turnaround, but we accept walk-ins and breakdowns at every location. Schedule online or call your nearest shop.

values.heading: Ready to get back on the road?
values.body: Schedule service online in a couple of minutes, or call your nearest Summit Ridge shop and we’ll find the first open bay.
